        if count > 1: flags.add('extra_origin')
        if count > 0 and record['request_frames'] == 0: flags.add('unsent_origin')
        if info and info['identity']: flags.add('identity')
        if info and info['mixed']: flags.add('mixed_origin')
        record['origin_count'] = count
        record['flags'] = sorted(flags)
    return {'cases': sent, 'channels': origin}
